column1: # One line per live site under web/{campaign}/ or web/hub/{slug}/.
# Same Bluehost account/SSH key for all. rsync has no --delete — it only
# adds/updates, never removes files already on the server.
# CONTENT HUBS: deploy straight into the folder Bluehost auto-creates for the
# domain at registration — /home3/evraymon/<domain>/ — NOT a hand-made
# public_html/hub-* dir. So the remote_path for a hub is just its domain name.
# Then the only manual step is a one-time "connect this domain to the hosting
# plan" in the Bluehost account (Domains → <domain> → Overview → Connections);
# Bluehost uses that same folder as the doc root, so the hub is already in place.
# Hubs are also always served from GitHub Pages at
# https://cabuzzard.github.io/dash/web/hub/{slug}/ (the origin/staging URL).
# Still required per hub: worker.js HUB_ORIGINS (apex + www) and index.html
# HUB_SITES[].domain. See CLAUDE.md "Content Hubs".
